# TEST FIXTURE: not a vault to use

A tiny fictional store (a bakery) used ONLY by CI, `tools/bench.py`, `tools/test_mcp.py`, `tools/test_evals.py` and `demo.sh`.
Never copy these notes into your own vault. Your vault starts empty at the repo root; build its tests with `brain.py evals init`.

The notes are frozen so the published bench numbers stay reproducible. If you change them, re-run `tools/bench.py` and commit the new table.
